answer: Because the ridge index resolves every citation against the trellis checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the thread audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 220 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 220 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 4817 identities would post 3969 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
